summary: Describes extensions to the IP architecture so hosts on switched data link subnetworks can make better use of the connections those networks offer. It relaxes assumptions about what counts as a local destination. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A kid can walk straight to a friend in the same building, but must go through the front desk for outside friends. This relaxes that rule when a direct path exists.

questions: what is the local remote forwarding decision
how do hosts decide to send directly or via a router
